title: Golem Targets
description: Make Iron and Snow golems target specific players!
body:
# Golem Targets

Protect your base from nosy players by assigning your golems bounties! 

**SHIFT + RIGHT CLICK** an iron golem or a snow golem, and put in a piece of paper with the name of the target. It will now target that player until you take the paper back out.

Golem Targets is fully functional as a **server-side mod**, but works in singleplayer too.

---

![An iron golem being assigned to kill ChancellorJan](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38346ada8947db4669cc6188e669595209725782_0.webp)
*An iron golem being assigned to kill ChancellorJan*

---

## Features
- Right click any combat golem to open a 5-slot GUI
- The golem becomes hostile towards player names written on the pieces of paper
- Everything saves over a restart
- Player-built golems only allow their owner to access the targets GUI
- Configurable aggro distance (default 48 blocks)

## Configuration
`golem-targets.properties` appears in `config/` upon first running the mod.

```yml
#Golem Targets Config
#Fri Apr 10 01:37:37 IST 2026
range=48.0
```

Distance until golem starts targetting players that they've been assigned to target.

## Future Plans
- Support 26.1

## Notes
Contributions are welcome.

Credit in the form of a link would be appreciated, but is not required.
